svg.title: P&ID column K 2750 (DEXPI Example C02) with HAZOP additions

g.text: P&ID column K 2750 (DEXPI Example C02) with HAZOP additions
HAZOP ACTION – SUMP HIGH LEVEL PROTECTION, K 2750
Added (red): feed from off the sheet through shutdown valve XV-2750 to nozzle N2;
LT-2750 on the sump (nozzle N8) → high level alarm LAH-2750 in the DCS (alarm only);
independent LT-2751 (nozzle N7) → SIS high-high level trip LSHH-2751.
On high-high level LSHH-2751 closes XV-2750 (spring return, fail closed).
The trip does not depend on the DCS: own transmitter, own nozzle, own logic.
Alarm and trip setpoints are not given – to be set (LAH below LSHH).
